audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet and with their own whys[] text: Level 3 read Heimerdinger while whys[2] calls it a skill window, Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] says he re-establishes control, Level 6 read Heimerdinger while whys[4] says your dash-in ultimate beats his zone, First item read Skill while whys[5] says he re-stabilises, and 2+ items read Heimerdinger while whys[6] says you out-scale him.
audit.why: The packet chart and the prose agree on all five; the audited mirror also agrees on Levels 4-5, First item and 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Level 3 Skill, Levels 4-5 Heimerdinger, Level 6 Yone, First item Heimerdinger, 2+ items Yone. Levels 1 and 2 left alone — see questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns and a mislabelled difficulty: diff reads EVEN but diffRating is 8.5/10, the tone is the red HARD colour, and report[14] says 'Hard matchup' on a 50.97% win rate.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter, which makes it the cleanest punish window in the lane. Hextech Micro-Rockets are 11s down to 7s at 1325 range. The turret is a 1-second cooldown, so turrets are never 'down'. UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s. Your Soul Unbound falls 22s to 10s; Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Difficulty aligned to EVEN at 6/10, and the grenade's flat 11s stated as the window you commit into.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has his W and E swapped throughout — it calls the stun grenade his W and the rockets his E. UPGRADE!!! is called 'CH-2 Electron Storm (R)' and described as rooting you. Fate Sealed is described as setting up team knockups.
audit.why: Hextech Micro-Rockets is W; CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — the stun — is E, on a flat 11s. UPGRADE!!! is R and empowers his NEXT SPELL rather than upgrading a turret into a root; against you that means a longer grenade stun, not a new form of CC. Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls — the knockup in this matchup is your own Mortal Steel at two stacks.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere; the ultimate described as empowering his next cast; Fate Sealed described as a blink-behind and pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged that the page never names any of his abilities correctly.
audit.why: H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, UPGRADE!!! and Hextech Affinity are the real names; Hextech Affinity also gives him move speed near his own turrets, which is why he kites best inside his nest.
audit.corrected: Real names written into spikes, early, mid and the wants rows.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Heimerdinger carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls the enemies it clips toward you instead of knocking them up. Heimerdinger carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The CH-2 Grenade is a flat 11s stun — step in only once he has spent it.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: CH-2 Grenade is a flat 11s stun and his only lockdown; Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units. Spent it? Q3-R him.

edits.before: Heimer's turrets (Q) plus Grenade (W) stun and Rockets (E) zone you off the wave and chunk you whenever you approach through his H-28 fire, so clear or dodge turrets before committing.
edits.after: His H-28 turrets (Q) plus Micro-Rockets (W) and the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun, a flat 11 seconds at every rank, zone you off the wave — clear or dodge the turret line before you commit.

edits.before: Your level 6 flips a window: E-in past the turrets and Fate Sealed him before he can CH-2 Electron Storm (R) upgrade a turret to root you mid-dash.
edits.after: Your level 6 flips it: E past the turrets and Fate Sealed him before UPGRADE!!! (R) empowers his next spell — that means a longer grenade stun, not a root.

edits.before: He stabilizes again at first item — an upgraded turret line and Grenade stun still punish a sloppy engage, so only all-in when W is down.
edits.after: He stabilizes at first item — an upgraded turret line and the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun punish a sloppy engage, so all-in only once that 11s is spent.

edits.before: Heimerdinger walls you off levels 1-2: his H-28 turrets (Q) chip you every time you go for CS and his Rockets (E) add poke, so you concede farm and never walk into a Grenade (W) stun. Trading into the turret line is a losing exchange before you have items.
edits.after: Heimerdinger walls you off levels 1-2: his H-28 turrets (Q) chip you every time you go for CS and Micro-Rockets (W) add 1325-range poke, so concede farm and never walk into the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun. Trading into the turret line loses before you have items.

edits.before: Level 3 is a brief skill window, but he re-asserts at 4 with a fuller turret setup. Your level 6 is the real opening — E past the turrets and R him before he can CH-2 upgrade a turret to root you. Miss that window and his Grenade stun punishes you.
edits.after: Level 3 is a brief skill window, but he re-asserts at 4 with a fuller turret setup. Your level 6 is the real opening — E past the turrets and R him before UPGRADE!!! empowers his next cast. Miss it and the CH-2 Grenade (E) stun punishes you.

edits.after: All-in with E + R when the CH-2 Grenade (E) is down

edits.before: Land the Grenade (W) stun to lock your dash
edits.after: Land the CH-2 Grenade (E) to stun your dash

notes: The content layer had his W and E swapped in every place they appeared — the stun grenade was called W and the rockets E — and his ultimate was written as 'CH-2 Electron Storm (R)' that 'upgrades a turret to root you'. UPGRADE!!! empowers his next spell; there is no root in his kit. Both corrected throughout. Five chart rows flipped in matched pairs where the packet, the prose and (for three of them) the mirror all agreed. Levels 1 and 2 left untouched: the packet and this page's own whys say Heimerdinger, the audited mirror says Yone at Level 1 and Skill at Level 2, and I had no basis to pick. The turret is on a 1-second cooldown, so any advice phrased as waiting for turrets to be 'down' is structurally wrong — the answer is killing them, which the wants.you[0] row already says correctly.
questionsForUser: Yone vs Heimerdinger, fields win[0]/win[1] and phases[0].side/phases[1].side: this packet and this page's whys both say Heimerdinger wins Levels 1 and 2, but the audited Heimerdinger mirror set Level 1 to Yone and Level 2 to Skill. Which side is authoritative? I left both rows unchanged rather than guess.
